name: rateb-erp-capacitor
description: RATEB ERP Capacitor shell (Android + iOS). Reuses Offline SDK from rateb-erp/public/assets/offline.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run sync:www && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run sync:www && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
